balls.text: fuller outside off, this is good bowling.. Miller drives it through off where the fielder at extra cover makes a good stop, keeps them to single
another good yorker, he gets an inside edge to short fine leg, who misfields.. but Miller will get a ball to play.. only single taken
fires this one on the block hole, Saha gets an inside edge to deep backward square leg, picks up a couple
fuller on off, he can play in front of the wicket too sir! Miller is all smiles as Saha smashes it over extra cover
goes down on his knee outside off early, and sweeps it in the gap at backward square leg, he falls over to the off side but he continues to feast
bowls a yorker outside off, the batsman cannot connect
full on the pads, Narine appeals for lbw but the umpire is not interested. Should have been out for me
brilliant Saha brilliant! He has a century.. Kings XI take a bow! This is length ball and it's hammered over long on, the fielder gets a hand and pushes it over the boundary.. What entertainment.
he waits deep in the crease, almost standing on the stumps, and pulls the length delivery across the line to deep midwicket boundary, just drops short of the boundary
why bowl filth when you are bowling well? Narine must wonder. He bowls a full toss on the pads and Saha has launched it over deep backward square leg
and again! this is wide outside off, the batsman misses the hoick
bowls the doosra outside off, Saha swings across the line, misses

goes for the reverse sweep straightaway, it's in the air and it's gobbled up by the tower at short third man. Anyone else and this would have gone for a boundary, but Morkel's tall frame comes to the rescue.
tossed up wide outside off, Saha comes down the pitch and chips it over extra cover for a single
flatter and wide outside off! Gimme more freebies, says Saha, before hammering it through cover off the back foot. The man was at extra cover, a bit too straight
comes down the pitch and drives it to deep extra cover, not much timing so this is stopped inside the boundary
murdered! Call 100.. this is carnage. Flatter deliver on off, Saha has whacked this so hard past the umpire that no one in the field moves

he almost fluffed the chance! Vohra wanted to send this to MG Road, but gets a big edge that looped high up in the night sky. Chawla calls early, gets under it.. But the ball bobs out of his hands.. it actually hits him on his face.. and bounces of his mouth. He is relieved to see it's still in his hands later. Gambhir is relieved too.. Wait a second.. relief? who's next?
Whoa!! Saha flatbats this back of length delivery to the sight-screen. Who's been watching French open?
fired on the pads, Umesh is lucky that the batsman doesn't get any bat on that.. it flicks the pads on its way to short fine leg
whoa! That made such a good noise off the bat! Length ball on off, Saha swings across the line but doesn't get the whole bat behind it, it falls in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
all falling apart for KKR! Umesh bowls a slower one wide down the leg side, Robin doesn't collect it cleanly..Kings Xi are loving this
slower and fuller outside off! Saha you brute beaut! He crashes it through extra cover.. no one moves.. Where can you place the fielders now
slower delivery on the leg stump line, Saha looks to pull that but misses
the deluge is getting suffocating for KKR! Length ball outside off, Saha throws his bat at that and slices it through backward point for a boundary
fuller on the pads, the batsman hammers it to deep midwicket for a quick single
this one is another harmless delivery, Vohra is down on the knee and hammers it over midwicket, but this one doesn't go too far
tossed up on off, this one is easier of the deliveries and Vohra smashes it down the ground.. Surya, at long-on, comes in and gets a hand, but can't keep it in

that is probably not going to hurt now because Vohra has been stumped! He was already outside the crease, looks to cut, gets beaten and is stumped easily. However, the umpire is checking if Uthappa has taken the ball in front of the stumps or not? Looks just about fine to me, but this could be a tight call here. The umpire has ruled in favour of Vohra.. It's a no-ball too because it was taken in front of the stumps

goes down on his knee, looks for the deep midwicket boundary, gets a doosra, gets a thick top-edge! Narine calls for it, but he has to run towards mid-on .. he gets there and gets under it but drops it
tossed up on the stumps, Vohra paddles it to deep backward square leg for a single to get Saha on strike
looks to play the late cut but gets beaten
fuller delivery on the stumps, now this is stylishly flicked in the gap at midwicket for a couple. That's century of the stand, that has come at the rate at which Gambhir talks. Manic.
short ball! This one is hooked over fine-leg and at Morke's place, this is alway going over... Bangalore has woken up.. KKR are now being stung the Punjabi way. Zinta is all smiles now
Shakib was moved to deep backward point but this one lands safely ahead of him! Vohra was looking to go over long on but got a thick outside edge
what a shot! This one has Sehwag written all over it.. Length ball on off, this is blasted over point and hits the boundary like a rocket

this is over the fence! How? Vohra clears the front leg, gets a length ball outside off and he chooses the slice.. His one hand came off the handle, so this shouldn't have gone far, but this clears the third man boundary
length ball outside off, the batsman nudges it to gully for a single
this is not what Gambhir wants to see! This is full on the pads, Vohra loves that length, he just has to get under it and smash it in the huge gap at cow corner. Now Vohra has a fifty too
now he watches this one closely and dabs it to cover for a quick single
looks for a pull and gets an underedge! This one is between Robin's legs.. Saha has fifty already.. hello, Kings XIs are here finally
and more! This one was flatter and turning in to Saha. He is good sweeper, and puller, he whacks this one behind square on the leg side.. Teases Morkel at the boundary
he is not going to stop! Saha continues to swing across the line, this time he gets loads of bat and clears the deep midwicket boundary
Saha swings across the line looking for the deep midwicket area, gets beaten as this one spins the other way
useful runs here now! The batsman shimmied down the pitch, got a yorker from Shakib, but he manages to squeeze it in the tiny gap between backward point and short third man
looks for a reverse sweep but Shakib has fired this full on the stumps, he can only push it to cover
another one! Not really.. This one just clears Yusuf at extra cover. Shakib fired it wide outside off and Saha only gets a toe to it
fires it full on the stumps, dug out to long on for a single
this stays a touch low outside off! Saha wanted to pull it over deep midwicket but gets hit on the pads, picks up a leg bye
he comes out of the crease and Shakib responds with a quick shorter one, the batsman flatbats it to deep midwicket
flatter delivery now and he is lucky that Saha finds short third man with the cut shot

and again! This is beautifully hit. Saha is quick on the feet, he comes out and surprises the bowler, who is tossing it up. Saha takes it on the half-volley and sends it over to the sight-screen. Huge hit this one
flat and powerful! The batsman takes a small step out, gets a half-volley and he hammers it over long-off
tossed up delivery, the batsman comes out of the crease and punches this to long on
comes down the crease and drives this fuller delivery inside out to wide long-off for a couple
comes down the pitch and yorks himself, digs it out to extra cover
and he goes for a sweep to one that is wide outside off, misses
now that sounds like a solid bat! It's marginally shorter from Shakib and Saha latches on to it, whacking it over deep midwicket with a powerful swing
nothing is working out for the batsmen today! Saha looks to reverse-paddle this one, but doesn't connect
he stays back and punches the flatter delivery to deep midwicket
slower and outside off, Vohra looks to drag it to the leg side but makes no connection, Uthappa whips the bails off and asks the question. Vohra is safe, never moved his back foot
flatter delivery on the stumps, the batsman goes deep in the crease and whips it to deep midwicket for a couple
another topspinner outside off, Saha looks for a cross-batted slog but this one slips under his bat
he waits on the back foot and cuts this regular legspinner straight to short third man
bowls a topspinner wide outside off, Vohra goes for a drive, expecting this to be googly, but this beats his outside edge
stays on back foot to a fuller delivery but manages to chop it towards point for a quick single
comes down the pitch and takes this flighted delivery on the full, drives it straight to long off
tossed up and full, pushed to mid-off for a single
he looks for the late cut but is beaten as he plays inside the line
fuller outside off, Saha is a confident sweeper, hits it to deep backward square leg with ease
flatter this time, the batsman waits in the crease and punches it to deep cover
he is slightly beaten by the length on this one - expected it to be shorter - but manages to push it to long off for a single
waits in the crease and dabs this one to gully for a quick single
bowls an arm-ball that the batsman wanted to nudge to the leg side, but he gets an inside edge on to his pads
the bowler responds with a googly, Vohra punches this one to long-on off the back foot to keep the strike
he gets under it this time! This was fuller and flighted on off, Vohra whacks it over deep midwicket for the first six of the innings
big spin for Chawla now, turns past the bat as the batsman tries to play a late cut
he comes down the pitch and eases the tossed up delivery to long on
this one is not short but Saha scythes his bat at that one, this time he gets the timing to find the boundary at deep midwicket
shorter delivery from Chawla, pulled hard in the gap at deep midwicket but this one is cut off by Pandey
waits in the crease and defends this one to cover
flatter and on the stumps, Saha nudges it to square leg for a single
he waits in the crease and punches the flatter delivery to deep midwicket
tossed up on the stumps, Saha stretches forward and sweeps it behind square on the leg side
tossed up delivery wide outside off, Saha lunges forward but gets beaten by the turn
flatter delivery on off, Vohra whips it to deep midwicket for a single

superb doosra bowled at pace! The batsman looks to push it to the leg side but gets beaten. What more, he falls over and the bails have been taken off by the keeper. The umpire wants to check for a stumping, but Saha is fine.. He never left the crease
he looks to push this flatter delivery to the leg side but gets a leading edge to cover, it was the other one
full and flighted on the pads, this time Saha whips it through square leg for a couple of runs
tossed up and full on off, Saha drives but can't beat cover
quicker delivery outside off, the batsman wants to cut it but gets beaten

and Narine strikes immediately! It's a wicket gifted by Bailey though. He walks into the shot and walks too far to the off side, missing the straighter delivery to be bowled behind his legs. KKR are on a roll now
quick short of length delivery outside off, Vohra tried to guide it to third man but misses
this one is off the middle! That takes some vertical distance but lands inside the boundary at deep midwicket, Yusuf keeps it in
he is lucky this time as he finally tries to go for the big shot on this fuller delivery, aims for long-on, but this goes over cover, clears infield
fires it full on the pads and Vohra misses out on some easy runs, it flicks the pads en route to the keeper
now Bailey goes for a quick single, dabs this one to the on side and calls early
he is playing the waiting game, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for a single
good tight line from Umesh, the batsman pushes the 141 kph delivery towards mid-on with soft hands and calls for a single
he defends the first delivery back to the bowler
Gambhir gobbles up the catch from his old friend! Sehwag was playing an ambitious pull of one that was not that short, and he got a big top edge towards mid-off where Gambhir takes an easy one
that is a smart whip behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs! Sehwag pushes for the second as Tendo doesn't pick up cleanly at the boundary
back of length delivery outside off, he gets good bounce on that one, Sehwag defends it back to the bowler
cracking sound off the bat as Sehwag punches this length delivery to cover
shortish delivery outside off with steep bounce, Vohra tries to ramp it over to the third-man boundary but makes no connection
and he bowls it on the pads again. Vohra plays the same shot as two balls ago, but there is a deep midwicket in place now

good ball! The keeper goes up in appeal for a caught behind, Morkel joins in later. It was a back of length delivery and it shoots off the pitch before beating the outside edge, it was far away from the bat
stays in the crease and defends the length delivery to cover
beautifully timed! Morkel bowls a full delivery on the middle stump and Vohra doesn't try to hit it too hard, just whips it over midwicket with a neat flick
he has looked good in defence, Vohra. Comes forward and pushes this length delivery to cover point
now this is classic Sehwag! Length ball, Sehwag brings his bat down in a quick swing and hammers it over the bowler's head
he is not moving his feet today! Manan tries to push at the full delivery away from the body and toe-ends it to mid-off. He is lucky that he didn't get too much bat on that one
outside edge and Sehwag gets off the mark! There is no slip in place and Morkel does well at third man to cut the boundary off
surprises him with a short delivery! Sehwag ducks under it just in the nick of time
fuller delivery on the stumps, some swing again, Sehwag punches it straight to mid-on
nice bit of outswing from the bowler and it beats the inside edge! Sehwag was looking to thrash it through cover, but over-accounted for the swing
loose shot! He throws his bat at this wide delivery, no movement of the feet, misses it completely
smartly done by Vohra! He dabs the back of length delivery through gully and because the third-man had moved finer, he gets an easy couple
no movement of the feet! Vohra pushes at it away from the body and gets a thick outside edge. There was just one slip in place, this went through third slip
Shakib at midwicket dives to his left to cut off the chance of a single. Vohra pushed the length delivery to the leg side
he gets on top of the bounce and dabs it past the left of the diving point fielder for a couple, he got behind the line nicely there
this one cuts in to the batsman, hits the pads and lobs up towards point. No bat on this, but they cross over

low full-toss, and it's all over! Chawla makes himself room and slices it over point and it runs away for four. Chawla is running around the ground like a madman, before he's pulled down to the ground by his teammates who fall all over him and smother him into the turf. What a win this is for Knight Riders!

whoa. Bailey dives to his left to make a super stop at midwicket after Narine flicks, and sends in a throw to the bowler's end. Narine was well short of his crease, but Awana was nowhere near the stumps, and Sehwag fumbles after backing up, but they don't run the overthrow
that's a good yorker, and Narine gets it off the bottom of his bat, straight to cover. Pressure!

that's short, and that's six! He didn't seem to be in the best possible position to pull, but Chawla's got more than enough bat on it after walking across his crease to send it soaring over the deep backward square leg boundary
that's in the blockhole again, following Narine who's opened up his stance. He can only bunt it onto his front pad
Narine makes himself room, and Johnson follows him with the full ball. He swings and misses, and the ball rolls down, narrowly past leg stump, to the keeper
he's pushed this full ball towards mid-off, who throws to the batsman's end, but Narine's home safe

that's full, angled towards off stump, and Surya looks to go leg side. Doesn't get hold of it at all, and Manan takes a simple catch at deep midwicket. Oh yes, it was the slower ball with the off-cutter action. May have deviated away from Surya after pitching
Surya slogs across the line from outside off, and doesn't really get hold of it, midwicket slides to his right to keep it down to two
skids in towards off from back of a length, and they risk the quick single to Bailey at cover and pull it off fairly easily
that's flat and quick again, pushed through towards off stump, and he can only defend it back to the bowler
slides across Chawla, who opens his face and pokes it towards point
another of those skidders homing into middle stump. Surya flicks it to midwicket
slower now, and Chawla flicks it towards deep midwicket
Chawla walks across his stumps, and it's called wide as Akshar fires it marginally down the leg side
that's flat, and angled towards the stumps again, and he's got an inside edge onto the front pad, trickles into the leg side

oh no! Pandey's been hitting against the turn with a lot of success, but doesn't get hold of it this time. It's sliced up high over cover, and Bailey takes a simple catch. Super innings, and he raises his bat to the crowd as he walks off
tries to go wide of off stump again, but overdoes it, and it's way wide of the tramline, and wide of the return crease as well
moves his line from wide outside off to wide outside leg, and Pandey's swept it away powerfully, behind square
that's another six, third time he's hit one right after a wicket's fallen. Again he's gone over long-on, and again he's made a super connection

Karanveer has his third! that's full and very wide again. Tendo tries to do a Pandey, looks to go over long-on, but he doesn't get the distance, and hits it straighter than he intended, and Miller is under it to take the catch well inside the boundary
tries a similar sort of shot, but it's too full to get under, and he's hit it along the ground towards long-on
that is some shot. He made it look easy. It was a legbreak tossed up well outside off, but he's swatted that with a lot of bottom hand and hit it clean over long-on
that's four! Akshar drops short for once, and Tendo is in position to cut it powerfully past point
that hurried through again and straightened just a little bit. Tendo is late on his flick and hits it back to the bowler off the outside half of his bat, almost a leading edge
that's a length ball, angling in towards the off stump, and Pandey makes himself room to run it off his bat-face towards deep point

he's done it again, has he? Bailey turned the second Qualifier around with his run-out of Raina, and he's run Shakib out here, with another direct hit. Shakib mishit it towards cover, and Bailey runs to the ball in a flash, turns, and sends in a pinpoint throw that catches Shakib well short at the bowler's end as he looked to take a tight single
Ah. Unlucky that, for Miller, who slides to his right from long-on to intercept that powerful drive from Shakib, but the ball still rolls back over the ropes
that's pushed through, just outside off, and Pandey muscles it to long-off
whoa. That's stunning from Shakib. It's in the blockhole again, but he doesn't care. He walks across his stumps and nonchalantly flicks it over his shoulder, one bounce over the fine-leg boundary

in the blockhole once more, very straight, and he's flicked it to midwicket. Bailey underarms a throw to the bowler's end, misses. Might have been close, since Pandey was dawdling outside his crease for a bit
angles onto the pads again, but almost it's in the blockhole, and the batsmen run two after Shakib flicks it to the right of Awana at deep backward square leg

that's short from Johnson and Shakib pulls it away. Akshar makes a super diving stop after running left from deep midwicket. Pushes it to Awana, who was running from the opposite direction, and he takes ages to get rid of the ball
that's a low full-toss, angled in, and Shakib is hit on the pad trying to flick it
that's a wide slower ball, and Bailey's done well to cut off that flat-batted slap, diving to his left from cover
back of a length, on off stump, and it's been slapped to deep cover
short again, and Pandey has pummeled that away to the left of deep midwicket
sees Pandey come down the pitch and fires it down the leg side again. Pandey swivels right around to regain his crease
Pandey, though, carries on as if nothing has happened. There was just a little bit of air on that, and he's swung it high and to the right of the long-on fielder
he's gone! Yusuf goes big again, and gets a lot of elevation but not quite enough distance, and Maxwell takes a simple catch right on the edge of the rope at long-on

that's a rubbish long-hop. Didn't seem to come out of his hand right, but Maxwell has done brilliantly to run to his right from long-on, cut off the pull, and fire in a powerful throw that erases any intention of running two
sees Pandey down the pitch, and bowls it well down the leg side. Pandey pads it away
slower ball, full-toss, and Yusuf has his fourth six, launched clean and high over long-on. This is terrible bowling
Pandey tries to play that tennis-smash pull again, and it goes off the bottom of his bat towards long-off
he telegraphed that scoop, and Balaji bowls it full and wide. He goes through with the shot anyway, and it pops into the vacant square leg region
that's full and wide, it's outside the tram-line, in fact, but Yusuf goes through with the big drive over cover, which is cut off by long-off running left
that's short, and Yusuf has pulled it from outside off, muscled it really, over the deep square leg boundary. All these short balls are sitting up nicely for the batsmen
that's full and wide, and he's thrown his arms at it to slash it towards deep cover
back of a length ball, slides in with the angle, and he's flicked it towards midwicket
shortish ball, flicked towards deep square leg

dropped! that was a strange shot from Pandey, trying to flick a shortish ball from outside off, and he gets a leading edge that pops over Bailey's head at cover. He gets an outstretched right hand to it, and it pops behind him, and he almost grabs the ball behind his back with his left hand
pulls his length back a bit, and Yusuf flicks that off his hips to deep square leg
full again, and he's pushed that into the covers
full and stump-to-stump, and Yusuf is hit on the front pad as he tries to flick. Going down leg, though
slower ball, and Pandey has spotted that even before it left the bowler's hand. He clears his front leg, gets into a low crouch, and his bat makes a lovely sound as he swats it over cow corner
that's a low full-toss, and it's jammed down to long-off
that's in the blockhole, and Pandey makes room to squirt it towrds cover.
that was hit hard, and Awana's done well to get down low and field it in his follow-through. It was full and Pandey threw everything at it
short again, and Pandey has pulled that high and hard over deep midwicket. Super 50 from the local boy
that's short, that's wide, and Pandey has creamed that with a flat bat to the right of cover and well to the left of long-off.
full, angled towards leg-and-middle, and Yusuf defends back to the bowler. That over took next to no time, and only cost Punjab 2 runs. Great start from Akshar
slides in from outside off, and Yusuf gets an inside edge onto his pads
gets a bit of a leading edge on this, ballooons safely down to long-on
pushed through again, and Pandey pushes it to cover
length ball, and Pandey is forward to defend back to the bowler
that's fired into the pads from wide of the crease, and Yusuf works it towards midwicket
bit of loop this time, and Pandey is beaten trying to drive, as the ball dips and turns past his outside edge
that's back of a length, and straightens towards off stump. It seemed to stick on the pitch and Pandey gets an inside edge into the leg side
shortens his length this time, and Yusuf slaps it to deep point
that's full again, tossed up, and not as wide, so this disappears over long-off instead. Miller almost got his hand to it, leaping and stretching himself painfully
that's full and wide, and Yusuf has a lot of room to swing freely and launch it over extra cover, with the turn
angles this in, outside leg, and Pandey clips it towards square leg
that's fuller, and very straight. Yusuf didn't seem to be expecting that length, and he gets down low to nudge towards midwicket
tries a similar shot, but it's shorter and outside off, and he gets an inside-edge to the left of the keeper
that's short, and Pandey is in the perfect position, having cleared his front leg, to swing cleanly and swat it to the straightish midwicket boundary
angled towards off stump, length ball, and Pandey makes room to try and squeeze it past cover, but Bailey makes a diving stop
another slower short ball and Yusuf leans back to chop it towards point
back of a length ball, angled in towards middle-and-off, and Yusuf plays it watchfully down the ground with a straight bat
Yusuf waits this time and plays it very late, with an open face, to short third man
back of a length, and Yusuf plays watchfully towards cover
this one pitches outside off and turns further away from off, and Pandey works his wrists to hit it towards midwicket
shortens his length this time, and Pandey waits on it and slices it to point
what a shot! it's full, and Pandey's swung cleanly through the ball to send it soaring over cover

and he's struck first ball! Gambhir comes down the track and heaves mightily at the ball without quite getting to the pitch of the ball. It goes high in the air and Miller, running to his left from long-on, takes it well inside the boundary
that's a waist-high full-toss, and Pandey mishits it down to deep backward square leg. The lack of timing on that swipe allows the batsmen to run two
that's back of a length and straight. Gambhir jumps up and knocks it down into the off side for yet another well-run single

down the pitch once more, almost yorks himself and hits the low full-toss to Mitchell Johnson at mid-on. He throws hard at the stumps at the keeper's end, hits them, and gives away four overthrows as third man fails to cut it off at the boundary
short ball, and Gambhir leans back to make himself room to chop it down towards deep backward point
down the pitch, but he can't really time that flat-batted hit. Aims towards the covers, hits it down to long-off
back of a length outside off, and Gambhir punches it in front of point
angles this into the pads, and Pandey picks up two with a nice bit of placement between short fine leg and deep square leg
another slower ball, and Gambhir, who has taken two steps down the pitch, adjusts to work it off his legs to square leg
that's a back-of-a-length ball, bottom-wristed away towards deep midwicket
slower bouncer, this time, angled in from wide of the crease. Pandey is very early into the pull, and the ball goes bouncing down to the keeper
slower ball, and Pandey plays it wristily back to the bowler
what a shot! Balaji angles it in and pitches it up. It's right in the slot, and Pandey punches it straight back over the umpire with a straight bat
makes room this time, and pushes the length ball towards cover with soft-ish hands
that's short, and it sits up, and Pandey swivels into this pull. Deep square leg runs around to his left to cut it off on the boundary
Pandey takes another step down the pitch and Awana shortens his length. Pandey calls "no" after punching into the covers
nice placement. Comes down the pitch and flicks it uppishly but safely from off stump. Johnson chases from mid on but his slide is futile.
lucky, lucky. Gambhir tries to flick this shortish ball and gets a leading edge that pops up over Virender Sehwag, who doesn't get near the ball as he turns around and runs back from midwicket
angles this one in towards off stump, and Pandey drives wristily towards mid-on
he's beaten the fielder. That's very full, and Gambhir skips quickly across his crease and drives with an open bat face to beat the cover fielder diving to his right
that's short and wide, leaves Gambhir off the pitch with a bit of away movement. Gambhir jumps up and tries to get on top of the bounce but gets nowhere near the ball
that's full and angling into Gambhir's pads. Hits the bottom of his bat as he looks to flick
Pandey tries to clear his front leg for the slog, but Johnson's bowled a slower ball and he hasn't picked it. Ends up trying to flick and jams it into his pads
short ball, and it rises towards Gambhir's neck, but he's jumped up to get right over the ball and knock it down by his feet
uh oh. Johnson's radar is going haywire here. Slides even further down the leg side this time
lovely shot. That isn't a half-volley, but Gambhir is in position early and right behind the line to drive this on the up to the left of point
that slingy left arm drops very low, and the attempted short ball slants well down the leg side. Gambhir moves himself out of the way
shortens his length a touch and angles it towards off stump. Gambhir waits on it and opens his bat-face to squirt it behind point
drifts onto the pads, but Akshar is on hand at deep midwicket to cut off that flick from Pandey
slower ball, and Gambhir comes down the pitch before mistiming a swipe towards mid-on. Went off the inside half of the bat
that's another wide half-volley. Even wider this time, and Gambhir has to reach across and play the flat-batted drive. David Miller makes a good stop, diving to his right from cover
pulls his length back a bit, and brings it closer to off stump, angling across. Gambhir has a look, but lets it go
and he starts off with a wide half-volley that Gambhir presses confidently forward to before driving with a high elbow past cover
bit of width, and Pandey is beaten as he chases at it without moving his feet
straight, back of a length, and Pandey whips it off his hip. It looked like it would go for a single, but it hurries away to the boundary, to the left of midwicket
